body: The sun had just begun to set behind the distant hills as I noticed my colleague’s face pale under the glow of headlights. They turned their gaze downward, staring blankly into nothingness, as if searching for the familiar comfort I felt in the warmth of my presence. My instinct was to reach out and touch them, to provide whatever solace they needed, but my hands were clenched tight around the steering wheel, afraid of hurting them more than helping.
